clips.title: The story
paras: Delicate Instruments is a quest in eastern Elwynn Forest focused on restoring magical stability to the Tower of Azora. Hamish Bergwort's sensitive equipment is being disrupted by erratic spellcasting practiced by nearby Defias rogue wizards. Resolving the disturbance requires putting an end to the amateur sorcery around Stone Cairn Lake.

Within the Tower of Azora, Hamish Bergwort attempts to conduct delicate magical experiments, only to be repeatedly interrupted by unexplained ambient disruptions. In an arcane sanctuary where precise measurements are everything, even slight ripples in the local magical weave can ruin hours of careful work. Bergwort suspects the disruptions are not natural, but rather the result of crude spells cast nearby.

The source of the magical static traces back to Stone Cairn Lake, where Defias rogue wizards have been practicing unchecked spellcraft. The Defias Brotherhood's reliance on rogue spellcasters introduces unstable, amateur magic into the Elwynn countryside. Dispatching these rogue wizards silences the magical noise, finally allowing Bergwort's sensitive instruments to register clean readings.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.

This is most frustrating, friend. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, friend.
